# MyYouTube

Optional discovery pointer for AI tools. This file is not the manual.

- Product: MyYouTube — personal Windows YouTube client (local subscription library, official IFrame player).
- Support knowledge base: [AI-SUPPORT.md](AI-SUPPORT.md) (version 0.1.17 in the current tree).
- Repository: https://github.com/MeaningfulnessMediaGroup/MyYoutube

Assistants should load `AI-SUPPORT.md`, not infer features from this stub.
